#### 5.1 BYLAW NO. 2037

The Mayor opened the Public Hearing for Bylaw No. 2037 at 5:42 pm.

Matthew Baldwin, Director of Planning and Subdivision, advised that Rachael Sansom of Grayland Consulting has applied on behalf of Navi Jagpal to amend the zoning of 904 to 914 Dunford Avenue from the 'One- and Two-Family Residential' Zone to the 'City Centre Pedestrian' Zone.

This is being proposed to allow for the development of two mixed-used buildings with approximately 352 residential units and 1,000m2 of commercial space.

In support of this application, the applicant has agreed to provide the following:

1. \$750 per unit to the Affordable Housing Fund;

2. \$2,850 per unit to the General Amenity Reserve Fund;

both subject to reductions in accordance with the Affordable Housing and Amenity Contribution Policy; and

3. \$10.75 per square meter of commercial space to the General Amenity Reserve Fund

Prior to bylaw adoption, the applicant will register a section 219 covenant that agrees to the following:

1. That all five properties be consolidated prior to issuance of a Development Permit.

2. That a separate covenant be registered prior to issuance of a building permit to ensure parking is allocated to each unit.

3. That a strata plan is registered for the building prior to issuance of an occupancy permit.

4. That 100% of residential parking stalls are capable of providing Level 2 charging for electric vehicles.

5. That a separate covenant containing a Housing Agreement securing approximately 10% of the residential units for the City's Attainable Home Ownership Program be registered prior to issuance of a building permit.

6. That full frontage improvements, a storm water management plan; and a construction parking management plan be provided and implemented to Bylaw 1000 standards to the satisfaction of the Director of Engineering prior to issuance of a building permit.

This proposal is consistent with the 'City Centre' designation of the Official Community Plan.

Notifications and advertisements have been placed as required by the Local Government Act.
